description: Unicode family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/generators/unicode.rs): 150 generated cases of seed 100 (the first ones whose templates hold at most 3000 bytes), recorded with the oracle; all match, so every vector must keep replaying identically. Covers the string filters and functions on random Unicode (case mapping, counting and cutting, trim masks, split, replace, format, nl2br, striptags, url_encode, json_encode flags, escaping strategies and charsets, convert_encoding), invalid UTF-8 and non-UTF-8 charset options. Regenerate with `twig-fuzz generate unicode --seed 100 --count 400`, the same selection and `twig-fuzz record`; recorded with "isolation": "process".
